Table_Binary.description: This table contains X-ray spectra and associated instrument parameters, as observed by the MESSENGER X-Ray Spectrometer (XRS). Detailed descriptions for the parameters defined below are contained in the XRS CDR SIS document.

Field_Binary.name: met
Field_Binary.description: Time tag in seconds, 0 = MESSENGER launch.

Field_Binary.name: orbit_number
Field_Binary.description: Orbit number is a unique identifier for a given orbit of the MESSENGER spacecraft around Mercury. Orbit number is defined as starting at apoherm and is calculated using the MET value and the appropriate SPICE kernels. Orbit numbering does not start until MESSENGER performs the Mercury orbit insertion. Until that time the value for orbit number is 0.

Field_Binary.name: status_interval
Field_Binary.description: Time period (in seconds) between status packets.

Field_Binary.name: sc_range
Field_Binary.description: +Z range to Mercury surface, smoothed. -1 means it can not be calculated.

Field_Binary.name: sc_angle
Field_Binary.description: +Z angle to Mercury surface, smoothed. -1 means it can not be calculated.

Field_Binary.name: data_quality
Field_Binary.description: Integer representation of a 32-bit array. Each bit represents a data quality flag. Currently only the least significant bit is being used. Other bit positions will be designated during the course of the mission as more data quality parameters are identified by the instrument team. =1, the actual data length in bytes does not match the reported length. =0, actual data length in bytes matches reported length.

Field_Binary.name: sw_version
Field_Binary.description: Software version number.

Field_Binary.name: alarm_id
Field_Binary.description: The identifier for the last XRS alarm, 0 for no alarm and non-zero for a long list of various parameters out of range.

Field_Binary.name: alarm_type
Field_Binary.description: Latest alarm type. =0 persistent, =1 transient.

Field_Binary.name: alarm_count
Field_Binary.description: Count of number of alarms.

Field_Binary.description: Number of commands executed.

Field_Binary.name: cmd_rejected
Field_Binary.description: Number of commands rejected.

Field_Binary.name: macros_executed

Field_Binary.name: macro_blocks
Field_Binary.description: Number of macro blocks free.

Field_Binary.name: gpc1_mg_safing_level
Field_Binary.description: The safing level set for the GPC1-MG detector. =0 level zero or nominal level safing; the software will monitor the planetary detector for the conditions which necessitate a higher level of safing. =1 level 1 safing; the HVPS voltage level for the affected sensor is ramped down to 0 at a rate of 100 V/sec. =2 level 2 safing; the software turns off analog power to the affected sensor and turns off the associated HVPS. No further attempts are made to restore the level-two-safed sensor to nominal safing. The software waits for ground command to reset the affected HVPS voltage levels.

Field_Binary.name: gpc1_mg_safing_retry
Field_Binary.description: The max number of retry attempts to reset the GPC1-MG detector to level 0 safing.

Field_Binary.name: gpc2_al_safing_level
Field_Binary.description: The safing level set for the GPC2-AL detector. =0 level zero or nominal level safing; the software will monitor the planetary detector for the conditions which necessitate a higher level of safing. =1 level 1 safing; the HVPS voltage level for the affected sensor is ramped down to 0 at a rate of 100 V/sec. =2 level 2 safing; the software turns off analog power to the affected sensor and turns off the associated HVPS. No further attempts are made to restore the level-two-safed sensor to nominal safing. The software waits for ground command to reset the affected HVPS voltage levels.

Field_Binary.name: gpc2_al_safing_retry
Field_Binary.description: The max number of retry attempts to reset the GPC2-AL detector to level 0 safing.

Field_Binary.name: gpc3_un_safing_level
Field_Binary.description: The safing level set for the GPC3-UNfiltered (UN) detector. =0 level zero or nominal level safing; the software will monitor the planetary detector for the conditions which necessitate a higher level of safing. =1 level 1 safing; the HVPS voltage level for the affected sensor is ramped down to 0 at a rate of 100 V/sec. =2 level 2 safing; the software turns off analog power to the affected sensor and turns off the associated HVPS. No further attempts are made to restore the level-two-safed sensor to nominal safing. The software waits for ground command to reset the affected HVPS voltage levels.

Field_Binary.name: gpc3_un_safing_retry
Field_Binary.description: The max number of retry attempts to reset the GPC3-UN detector to level 0 safing.

Field_Binary.name: discarded_packet_counter
Field_Binary.description: Number of calls to send-pkt that resulted in a return value of false.

Field_Binary.name: tec_loss_of_control
Field_Binary.description: TEC loss of control flag. =0 no loss of control, =1 loss of control.

Field_Binary.name: solar_flare_detected
Field_Binary.description: Solar flare detection flag. =0 no solar flare detected, =1 flare detected.

Field_Binary.name: flare_handling_enabled
Field_Binary.description: Solar flare handling enabled flag, software checks this value upon detection of a solar flare. =0 do not handle solar flare detection. =1 continue algorithm for handling solar flare detection (see SOLAR_FLARE_ENACT).

Field_Binary.name: flare_handling_enacted
Field_Binary.description: Solar flare handling enacted flag. Allows software to determine if solar flare handling has already been enacted or whether this is a new detection of a solar flare. Only checked if solar flare handling has been enabled (see previous field). =0 the software sets it to true, starts the sf-time-enactable-left counter out at sf-max-time-enactable, sets a flag telling the 1Hz process to end the current integration and reporting period immediately, and returns control to the 1Hz process. =1 , the software decrements the sf-time-enactable-left counter and checks its value. If sf-time-enactable-left is still greater than 0, the algorithm does nothing further. If sf-time-enactable-left has reached 0, the algorithm starts the sf-timeout-left counter out at sf-timeout-period and sets the sf-handling-enacted-now flag to false.

Field_Binary.name: solar_stability
Field_Binary.description: A 10 element array of solar monitor detector rate measurements. The integration period is divided into 10 equal segments with an accumulated rate (per second) for each. Valid data for this column is only obtained by the instrument if solar flare handling is enabled at the start of the integration and reporting period.
